likelyQuestions: Classify whether the feasible set of an LP in standard form is always bounded, providing appropriate mathematical justification or a counterexample.
Explain the role of constraints and feasible regions in real-world mathematical optimization problems with suitable illustrations.
Formulate a given design problem as a mathematical programming problem and detail its real-world applications.
Analyze a transshipment problem with supply and demand nodes to determine the feasibility conditions and spanning-tree solutions.
Propose a shortest path or network flow formulation for an equipment replacement problem involving maintenance costs and trade-in values over multiple years.
Describe the steps, nature, and advantages of the Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm with real-world applications.
Illustrate the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) technique, explain the velocity update equations, and compare it with Genetic Algorithms.
Discuss how Particle Swarm Optimization differs from Ant Colony Optimization and analyze scenarios where one performs better than the other.
Define decision-making and illustrate the role of decision trees in classification and prediction for solving real-world problems.
Explain general decision-making styles using examples and analyze the advantages and disadvantages of group-aided decision-making in knowledge management.
